liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eternity** (2 reviews): Reviewer found this specific performance spooky, noting it as the only standout moment in a tired show; Watching big screens showing a rocky beach with waves, the reviewer felt a scary sense of timelessness [3][13]
- **Deal** (2 reviews): Deal ended the first set really well, while the second set hit some good jams; The closing Deal was decent, though not as good as the Nassau performance from March 27, 1994 [8][10]
- **Box of Rain** (1 review): The reviewer noted an unusual Box of Rain opener and a good Jack Straw performance [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Childhood's End**: rare: 13 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd94-08-04.akg.wiley.8729.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 195 min; rated 2.67/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as poor, though the show itself did not sound all that bad [5]
- **gd1994-08-04.147726.schoepsCMC5MK21.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 188 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Security sprayed the reviewer with mace, ordering them to leave and abandon their friends [3]
- Three friends from Baltimore drove in a Mitsubishi Eclipse, living out of the car for the weekend [6]
- Jerry appeared to be using drugs, playing sloppily, while Weir looked unhappy on the monitors [11]
- The reviewer rode in the back of a Ryder moving van from Auburn Hills due to car troubles [12]
- Bruce Hornsby played accordion in the second set, while Jerry played guitar with Traffic during two songs [2]
- The show was decent, making up for the previous night's awful performance [7]
- The band atoned for the atrocious previous night, delivering a decent job this time [8]
- The reviewer found this night average to better, contrasting it with the near-walkout prior night [10]
- The tapes sound much better than the reviewer remembers the show being, though still not great [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-08-04.akg.wiley.8729.sbefail.shnf**: source: Audience: AKG 460's [1]. Also: Recorded with AKG 460 microphones, transferred from DAT to CDR, then processed with Cool Edit Pro [1]
- **gd1994-08-04.147726.schoepsCMC5MK21.ebel.flac16**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB Schoeps CMC5 Mk 21-> DAT [2]. Also: Source 008729 used AKG 460s to cover patches of digital static in I Need A Miracle and Throwing Stones [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Giants Stadium - August 4, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/august-4-1994) [16]
